name: Engineering workflow reviewer regression v1
description: Thirty newly authored reviewer-component cases covering the expanded engineering workflow contexts. This suite was authored separately from the original forty Week4 claims. It is a new development regression set with AI-proposed pending labels, not a completed human-reviewed golden benchmark or a claim of unseen generalization.
source_policy: Context text equals the pinned UTF-8 fixture bytes. Source comments identify frozen repository origins; no file is executed. Scenario/title/expected/rubric/label fields are evaluator annotations and must never enter model inputs. Evidence anchors measure literal lexical coverage only, not entailment, correctness, or useful diagnosis. Minimum item counts are structural proxies. Expected labels and human rubrics are AI-proposed and pending actual human review. Reviewer factual evidence consists only of the selected quote. Each quote pins a complete frozen fixture using inclusive line bounds and whole-file SHA-256. Synthetic logs support attributed controlled-example observations only; test definitions establish assertions rather than successful execution; unapplied diffs establish proposed changes rather than deployment outcomes.

def _public_source(source):
    if source.get('origin') not in {'snapshot', 'live'} or source.get('kind') not in {
        'documentation', 'issue', 'release', 'contributing', 'code',
    }:
        raise ValueError('Publication supports must contain public source evidence only.')
    url = canonical_http_url(source.get('url', ''))
    parts = urlsplit(url)
    if (parts.scheme != 'https' or parts.hostname not in _PUBLIC_HOSTS
            or parts.port not in (None, 443) or parts.query):
        raise ValueError('Publication supports need approved public HTTPS source links.')
    path = unquote(parts.path)
    if (parts.hostname == 'github.com' and
            (not (path == '/streamlit/streamlit' or path.startswith('/streamlit/streamlit/'))
             or '\\' in path or any(part in {'.', '..'} for part in path.split('/')))):
        raise ValueError('GitHub publication evidence is limited to streamlit/streamlit.')
    if hashlib.sha256(source['text'].encode()).hexdigest() != source.get('sha256'):
        raise ValueError('The registered public evidence failed its integrity check.')
    return url

def test_serial_batches_are_bounded_and_coverage_is_complete(source_records, tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    requests = install_http(monkeypatch, successful)
    index = make_index(source_records, tmp_path)
    vectors = index.embed_documents([f"text-{i}" for i in range(65)])
    assert vectors.shape == (65, 4)
    assert [len(r["json"]["input"]) for r in requests] == [32, 32, 1]
    assert [r["input_count"] for r in index.calls] == [32, 32, 1]
    assert sum(r["usage"]["total_tokens"] for r in index.calls) == 54

def _public_source(source):
    if source.get('origin') not in {'snapshot', 'live'} or source.get('kind') not in {
        'documentation', 'issue', 'release', 'contributing', 'code',
    }:
        raise ValueError('Publication supports must contain public source evidence only.')
    url = canonical_http_url(source.get('url', ''))
    parts = urlsplit(url)
    if (parts.scheme != 'https' or parts.hostname not in _PUBLIC_HOSTS
            or parts.port not in (None, 443) or parts.query):
        raise ValueError('Publication supports need approved public HTTPS source links.')
    path = unquote(parts.path)
    if (parts.hostname == 'github.com' and
            (not (path == '/streamlit/streamlit' or path.startswith('/streamlit/streamlit/'))
             or '\\' in path or any(part in {'.', '..'} for part in path.split('/')))):
        raise ValueError('GitHub publication evidence is limited to streamlit/streamlit.')
    if hashlib.sha256(source['text'].encode()).hexdigest() != source.get('sha256'):
        raise ValueError('The registered public evidence failed its integrity check.')
    return url
